summary: Frontend-only testing of 'Pengalaman Klien' testimonial slider across desktop/tablet/mobile. All 6 feature acceptance criteria verified passing. New 4th testimonial (Citra Larasati) rendered with correct name, role, and full quote. Slider computes pages dynamically, prev/next disabled states correct, dots active state updates on scroll/click, no horizontal overflow at any width, floating WhatsApp CTA unaffected, resize recomputes dots.

issues: First card renders at ~78.9% of slider clientWidth instead of exactly ~86% because .testi-grid padding (16px each side) is included in clientWidth while flex-basis:86% is computed against content box. Visually still shows ~1 card with peek of next, matching intended UX. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: HomeTestimonials Slider measure() depends on children offsets; works correctly here but if gap changes dynamically (e.g., font load shift) initial measure before layout could mis-compute. Current impl recomputes on scroll/resize so acceptable.

Mobile card flex-basis uses 86% but slider has 16px side padding — effective visible width is ~79%. If exact 86% is required by spec, consider calc((100% - 32px) * 0.86) or move padding outside the scroll container.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testimonial slider verified end-to-end at 1440/768/390. 4 cards, dots counts 2/3/4 respectively, prev/next and dot states behave correctly, scroll syncs active dot, no page overflow, WA floating button intact. Only observation: mobile card width is 78.9% rather than 86% (padding math). Not a functional bug.
